name: The Orphan Train 孤儿列车
detailed_description:
The once-notorious serial killer Kane has returned, determined to hunt down the survivors who narrowly escaped his grasp years ago. Madness and distortion permeate the entire world. Towns, hospitals, abandoned orphanages, and silent forests—all are filled with absurdities and unspeakable secrets. Is this a cycle of retribution, or an intricately planned deception?

He will come—inevitably!

And she has been waiting all along!

To prevent the arrival of this unspeakable horror, you must confront all kinds of terrifying entities!

Fight against them!

Survive the countless shocks and horrors in this first-person survival horror game that feels like descending into the eighteen levels of hell!

  • Take control of the protagonist James, uncover the truth buried in that incident twenty years ago, and unravel the absurd mysteries surrounding you!

  • Explore multiple large maps, each offering a unique blend of horror elements!

  • Different clues will lead to different endings!

  • Accompanied by deeply immersive horror music—will you make it out alive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 or Intel® Arc™ A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low/Medium quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 30 FPS. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 2080RTX or AMD Radeon™ 6800XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Medium quality settings in 60 FPS or High quality settings in 30 FPS, in FullHD (or 4k using DLSS or similar technology). SSD is recommended.
